answer: An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The umber counter is kept in velvet and beacon makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2694 identities would post 3990 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
